outline:
建議先修課程：精實製造工程。介紹最新精實製造系統和實務工具，主題包括： 1.精實製造系統概論 2.價值溪流分析 3.快速更換 4.使用點 5.源流品質 6.團隊 7.全員生產維護 8.後拉式/及時/看板生產系統 9.單元小組製造
Suggested Prerequisite: Lean Manufacturing Engineering. Introduction to state-of-the-art lean manufacturing systems and practical tool sets. Tentative topics include: 1. principles 2. value stream mapping analysis 3. single minute exchange of die 4. points of usage and etc.
assessment:
Maximum three absences with or without excuses
Notebook computer in-class activities
Homework 10%
Tests 50%
Term project 25%
Final report 15%
